summary.text: Shane Mack is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 95 (Livingston and Tangipahoa parishes), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Shane Mack's occupation as Retired Logistics Manager.
It lists education as B.S., Southeastern Louisiana University.

The page lists committee assignments including Appropriations, Judiciary, Natural Resources and Environment, and the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus affiliations including the Capital Region Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Rural Caucus and the Northshore Delegation.
